no_kyc_track._note: Cards marketed as no-KYC / low-KYC. Nothing here is verified until it has a record. Inclusion rule (David, 2026-11-09 — replaces the 'issuer or operator named' condition): a card enters the catalogue when (1) the operator's own official pages publish its fees and state when identity verification is or is not required (thresholds/limits), (2) the product is active and orderable, and (3) the operator's own terms do not restrict it to one territory while forbidding solicitation elsewhere. An undisclosed issuer or operator is allowed and is shown as 'not disclosed' on the card page. Third-party claims never count. Never describe how to avoid checks.
